courses.name: Entrepreneurship (Minor Course)
courses.description: Specialized minor course in startup mechanics & venture creation

questions.questionText: What is the primary objective of building a Minimum Viable Product (MVP)?
options: To maximize immediate commercial sales revenue
To accelerate validated learning with minimum resources
To satisfy all enterprise feature requests upfront
correctOptions: To accelerate validated learning with minimum resources
questions.explanation: According to Lean Startup principles, an MVP aims to test fundamental business hypotheses quickly with the least effort.

questions.questionText: What term describes the rate at which a new venture consumes its cash reserves before generating positive cash flow?
questions.explanation: Burn rate measures monthly net negative cash flow.

questions.questionText: Which blocks are included in Osterwalder's Business Model Canvas?
questions.explanation: All four are key pillars among the 9 building blocks of the Business Model Canvas.

questions.questionText: Bootstrapping refers to financing a company exclusively through external venture capital funds.
questions.explanation: Bootstrapping means self-funding a venture using personal savings and operational cash flow, without external equity funding.

questions.questionText: What is the acronym for the metrics that assess cost to acquire a single customer?
questions.explanation: CAC stands for Customer Acquisition Cost.
